_doc: Loop-candidates register. Any loop that spots a monetization/expansion path (or any capability) with NO existing loop appends a line here instead of dropping it. /sharpen reads this, and when the same candidate recurs (>=2x) proposes scaffolding it into a real loop. This is how the loop family self-extends. Fields: ts, from_loop, candidate (the missing angle/loop), why, example_idea.

_example.why: buying an existing small business in the space can be faster than building

why: buy an existing agency / book of regulated-niche clients to skip cold-start (rollup / M&A) - an expansion path with no loop
